# AURA Approval Policy — Site Inspections

## Purpose
This policy defines the criteria for approving site inspection reports before
works can proceed.

## Approval Criteria

### Mandatory Conditions
1. All HIGH severity findings must be resolved and independently verified.
2. Written confirmation from a licensed contractor is required for electrical findings.
3. Photographic evidence of remediation must be attached to the approval record.

### Conditional Approval
A conditional approval may be granted when:
- All HIGH severity findings have confirmed remediation plans with hard deadlines.
- MEDIUM severity findings have acknowledged plans within 30 days.
- The approving officer has reviewed the inspector declaration.

### Rejection Criteria
An approval must be rejected when:
- Any HIGH severity finding remains unresolved without a plan.
- The inspector declaration is missing or incomplete.
- Outstanding findings pose an immediate risk to occupants.

## Approving Officer
Approval notes must be prepared by the designated safety officer and countersigned
by the building owner or their authorised representative.

## Record Retention
All approval notes and supporting evidence must be retained for 7 years in
the AURA document management system.
